text:
maria: Heads up — need to lock 12 A100 GPUs in apac-staging (asia-south1) for new cluster bring-up next Wed. Can we start quota request + soft reserve?
ken: What's the sku/series? req for preflight or prod?
tim: Preflight to validate autoscaler/eviction, but capacity should be reserved as if prod.
maria: 12x a100-80GB, 2x100Gb NICs per node. It's staging but we need a dedicated pool to run full perf regressions.
ken: That region has seen spikes. Suggest including fallback region in the request. Also remember ENI/VPC quotas.
sophie: I can handle finance loop. Approx budget for first month?
maria: Budget ~ $35k for initial month incl network. Finance approval needed but procurement can start.
infra-bot: infra-bot: No existing dedicated pool tagged apac-staging. apac-sim has 8 GPUs free; recommend reserve request for 12 to avoid rollout delays.
tim: Plan: 1) file cloud quota ticket (GPUs + ENIs), 2) submit internal capacity reservation with procurement, 3) provision 2-node test cluster, 4) run validation checklist and smoke tests.
maria: gcloud example to paste in ticket:
```
gcloud compute quotas update --project=redwood-staging --region=asia-south1 --metric=GPUS --limit=12
# justification: "cluster bring-up: staging inference runtime validation"
```
ken: For the capacity reservation, include start/end dates, preflight window (72h), and allow soft-fail if unused. Tag reservation: team=eng-infra project=apac-staging.
sophie: Which billing center? Cloud-Staging or R&D-Infra? Need exact code for PO.
maria: Use Cloud-Staging for initial PO; finance can reassign internal charge later.
tim: Also request increases for ephemeral external IPs and LB forwarding-rule limits — we hit 64 last time.
ken: Node pool plan: 3 worker nodes first pass (4 GPUs per node). Node template: a100-80gb, 2x100g NIC, local-ssd=2x375GB. Include taints for experiments.
sophie: I'll draft the internal PO today and attach cost estimate. ETA: Tue EOD.
maria: @deploy-bot can we schedule a dry-run deployment next Thursday? Need to smoke test OOM/placement and KV cache behavior.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled "apac-staging-dryrun" for 2024-05-16 10:00 UTC. Notified owners: maria, ken, tim.
ken: If quota is delayed, fallback option: spin smaller test pool with 80GB vGPU slices, but perf will differ; document in the runbook.
maria: Uploading provider justification now. Will paste support ticket id in this thread once submitted.
tim: Also note: request automatic capacity fallback to apac-sim pool for 2 weeks if primary can't be fulfilled, so rollout isn't blocked.
sophie: Good idea. I'll add fallback clause to the PO.
maria: Thanks all — I'll update when ticket is created. Keep any cost/limit blockers here."
